title: The Ethical Debt
subtitle: Why wasting animal data is wasting animal lives
thesis_question: If animals are used to generate scientific knowledge, does allowing the resulting data to become unfindable, unusable, or unreused constitute a distinct ethical failure of animal research — an 'ethical debt' — and can treating data stewardship (FAIR data, reuse, virtual control groups, NAM-generated data) as a dimension of animal welfare and of the 3Rs help repay it?
audience: Preclinical and biomedical researchers, laboratory-animal scientists and 3Rs/animal-welfare specialists, research-data stewards and FAIR/open-science practitioners, funders, journal editors, and regulators of animal research.

clusters.name: Preclinical reproducibility and translational failure
topics: publication bias and non-publication of animal studies
underpowered animal experiments and statistical power
systematic reviews and meta-analyses of animal models
risk of bias in in vivo research

clusters.name: The 3Rs, animal welfare ethics, and Reduction
topics: Replacement Reduction Refinement (3Rs) principle and evolution
moral status and ethics of animal experimentation
the moral contract of animal research

clusters.name: FAIR data principles and research data management
topics: FAIR guiding principles (Findable Accessible Interoperable Reusable)
research data management in the life sciences
cost and value of data sharing

clusters.name: Biomedical data sharing, repositories, metadata standards and ontologies
topics: minimum information reporting standards (MIABE, MIAME, ARRIVE-adjacent data standards)
electronic lab notebooks and data capture

clusters.name: Virtual control groups, historical controls, and control-data reuse
topics: virtual control groups in toxicology and preclinical studies
historical control data in regulatory studies
control-group reuse as a Reduction strategy
meta-analytic reuse of animal control data

clusters.name: New Approach Methodologies (NAMs) and non-animal data
topics: New Approach Methodologies in toxicology and biomedicine
read-across and integrated approaches to testing and assessment (IATA)
data infrastructure and reusability of NAM-generated data

clusters.name: Research incentives, meta-science, and open-science reward systems
topics: incentives for data sharing and credit for datasets

clusters.name: Reporting guidelines and research governance
topics: ARRIVE guidelines and reporting quality of animal studies
journal and funder policies on animal research reporting
roadmaps and infrastructure for data reuse

sections.title: Introduction
sections.scope_notes: Frames the moral contract of animal research and defines the central construct: the 'Ethical Debt' incurred when animals are used to generate data that is then allowed to become unusable. States the thesis that data welfare is a dimension of animal welfare. Written LAST (Phase 11); may only cite papers already introduced in body sections.

sections.title: The Reproducibility and Translation Crisis in Preclinical Research
sections.scope_notes: Establishes the empirical scale of the problem: irreproducibility, translational attrition, non-publication and file-drawer loss, underpowering, and the resulting waste of animals and knowledge. Quantifies where possible; surfaces conflicts between optimistic and pessimistic estimates.

sections.title: From Animal Welfare to Data Welfare: Reframing the 3Rs
sections.scope_notes: Develops the conceptual core: situates 'data welfare' within the 3Rs (especially Reduction) and the ethics/harm-benefit tradition, and argues data stewardship is part of the moral contract. Engages counter-arguments about whether data reuse is genuinely a welfare/3Rs concern.

sections.title: FAIR Principles and the Preclinical Data Ecosystem
sections.scope_notes: Surveys FAIR principles, standards, ontologies, repositories, and persistent identifiers as applied to preclinical/animal data; assesses the state and barriers of adoption, and the gap between FAIR aspiration and preclinical practice.

sections.title: Virtual Control Groups and Data Reuse as Reduction
sections.scope_notes: Examines virtual/historical control groups, shared control databases, and secondary use/meta-analysis as concrete mechanisms that convert reusable data into fewer animals used. Weighs methodological risks (bias, comparability) against Reduction gains.

sections.title: New Approach Methodologies and the Data They Generate
sections.scope_notes: Reviews NAMs (in vitro, organoids, organ-on-chip, in silico) and argues that NAM-generated data faces the same stewardship and reuse challenges; without FAIR data, NAMs risk recreating the ethical debt in a non-animal form.

sections.title: Incentive Structures and the Political Economy of Research Data
sections.scope_notes: Analyzes why usable data are nonetheless wasted: publish-or-perish, weak credit for datasets, funding and career incentives, and the economics of research waste. Draws on metascience evidence.

sections.title: Governance, Standards, and Pathways to Repayment
sections.scope_notes: Assesses policy and infrastructure levers — reporting guidelines (ARRIVE/PREPARE), mandates, oversight bodies, repositories — and synthesizes a roadmap for repaying the ethical debt. Evaluates evidence for what interventions actually change behavior.

sections.title: Conclusion
sections.scope_notes: Synthesizes the argument that data welfare is animal welfare and that repaying the ethical debt is a collective obligation. Written LAST (Phase 11); introduces no new citations.

evidence_parameters_provenance: User prompt specified: 'Target ≥200 papers per cluster, snowball 2 rounds', 'Saturation criterion: <2% new unique in last 100', 'Total bibliography target: ≥1000'. A numeric per-cluster floor was given, so min_papers_per_cluster=200 (not null); saturation and snowball both apply. The prompt does not contain the substrings 'saturate', 'cover all', or 'every relevant', so the null-floor branch is not triggered.

steps.title: Design clusters, sections, and targets from the user TOC
steps.description: Read provenance/review_request.md; define 8 evidence clusters, 9 sections (Intro + 7 body + Conclusion), length targets, and parse evidence_parameters (min_papers_per_cluster=200, saturation '<2% new unique in last 100', snowball_rounds=2, total_bibliography_target=1000). Return scope.json with plan_content and cluster_to_section_assignment.

steps.title: Materialise provenance and gate_scope artifacts
steps.description: Write provenance/review_request.txt (verbatim), provenance/review_request.md (three-section render + SHA256), and gate_scope.json (title, clusters, sections, evidence_parameters, review_request_path). Verify no template placeholders remain. Coordinator verifies: Phase 1V validator returns gate=pass on all 11 checks before generate_plan.

steps.title: Search databases and extract findings per cluster
steps.description: For each of 8 clusters, query PubMed/Europe PMC/CrossRef, extract findings with verbatim source sentences and API-sourced DOIs/metadata, retrieve full text (≥50% target), then run snowball_rounds=2. Continue until min_papers_per_cluster=200 AND saturation '<2% new unique in last 100'. Save findings JSON every 30 papers; return continuation_required when the per-frame budget is hit. Coordinator verifies: papers≥200/cluster, conflicts>0, figure_data≥2/cluster, and Phase 2V evidence-validator confirms source sentences resolve, DOIs resolve, fulltext honesty, and BIBLIOGRAPHY_FLOOR_HARD (≥1000 DOIs) before advancing.

steps.title: Build citation_key_map and author_name_table via CrossRef
steps.description: Query CrossRef for every DOI; generate unique citation keys and an author-name table. Coordinator verifies: Phase 3V citation-validator confirms CrossRef matching, key format and uniqueness, author match; citation_key_map version id is non-null (null blocks all downstream).

steps.title: Build argument arc, section plans, figure specs, style guide
steps.description: Produce the scaffold: overall argument arc, per-section plans, ≥2 figure specifications per section (with cross-study comparisons where possible), cross-references, and a style guide. Coordinator verifies (inspection): ≥2 figures/section, cross-refs present, conflicts represented; save gate_scaffold_approved.json.

steps.title: Assign clusters to sections and build per-section evidence packages
steps.description: Using cluster_to_section_assignment, deduplicate and assign findings/conflicts to sections; attach citation keys; build scaffold extracts. Coordinator verifies: Phase 5V curation-validator confirms no duplicates, anti-compression ≥75%, conflicts assigned, per-section paper counts meet floors; save gate_evidence_curated.json.

steps.title: Blinded audit of figure_data comparability
steps.description: Critic agents (NOT the scaffold authors) review each figure's underlying data for comparability, returning PASS/CAVEAT/SPLIT/REDESIGN. Coordinator pre-fetches paper abstracts and passes them inline (critic has no network). Coordinator verifies: 0 REDESIGN remaining; critic frame IDs ≠ author IDs; save gate_figure_audit.json.

steps.title: Draft each body section with MyST + LaTeX + figures + notebooks
steps.description: One writer per body section (sections 02-08). Save .md prose BEFORE generating figures. Use :::{figure} colon fences, {cite:p}/{cite:t} keys, per-figure notebooks in figures/notebooks/. Filter citation_key_map to that section's keys only. Coordinator verifies: Phase 7V myst-validator confirms :name: not :label:, cite keys exist, ≥4.0 citations/synthesis paragraph, word/citation/figure counts; save gate_sections_drafted.json.

steps.title: Blinded prose critique across 6 tracks
steps.description: Critic agents (IDs ≠ writer IDs) review each section for evidence fidelity, conflict representation, and coverage, emitting MUST_FIX/SHOULD_CAVEAT/MINOR and a coverage classification of every uncited paper. Coordinator loops send-backs until MUST_FIX=0 and no unaddressed SHOULD_CITE; save gate_critic_complete.json.

steps.title: Build references.bib from CrossRef
steps.description: Generate ASCII-only BibTeX entries from CrossRef for every cited key; dedup; scan for contamination. Coordinator verifies: Phase 9V citation-validator confirms bib matches CrossRef, all keys present, 0 contamination; save gate_bibliography.json.

steps.title: Six integration passes across the body
steps.description: Run passes for transitions, cross-references, terminology consistency, narrative continuity, figure numbering (\ref not hard-coded), and structural hygiene. Coordinator verifies (inspection): 6 passes documented, no filename mismatches; save gate_integration.json.

steps.title: Write Introduction and Conclusion last
steps.description: Draft sections 01 and 09 after all body sections; they may ONLY cite papers already used in the body (no new citations). Coordinator verifies (inspection): no new citation keys introduced; save gate_intro_conclusion.json.

steps.title: Blinded critic on intro/conclusion
steps.description: Critic (ID ≠ writer) verifies every claim-citation pair in the intro/conclusion and that no novel uncited claims were introduced. Coordinator loops until MUST_FIX=0; save gate_bookend_critic.json.

steps.title: Render Methods.md from pipeline metadata
steps.description: Build content/Methods.md (8 subsections) documenting scope criteria, evidence parameters, search strategy, verification, and the pipeline ledger; embed the review-request prompt block. Coordinator verifies: 8 subsections present, ledger sub-block populated; save gate_methods.json.

steps.title: Assemble manuscript, update myst.yml toc, wire figures/notebooks
steps.description: Collect all section .md, figures, notebooks; update myst.yml toc (do not rewrite from scratch); inject :::{dropdown} figure-code blocks matching figure count; build LaTeX. Coordinator verifies: Phase 14V myst-validator passes myst build plus all structural checks (BIBLIOGRAPHY_PATH_MATCHES_MYSTYML, BIB_CITE_KEYS_RESOLVE, EVIDENCE_PACKAGES_POPULATED, FIGURE_DROPDOWN_MATCH, FIGURE_NOTEBOOK_MATCH/SELF_CONTAINED, HEADING_STYLE_CONSISTENT, REVIEW_REQUEST_CAPTURED, PLUGIN_DIRECTIVES_INVOKED, NO_WRITER_SCRATCHPAD, CITE_DIRECTIVE_SYNTAX_CLEAN); save gate_assembly.json with section_md_vids_final.

steps.title: Exhaustively extract citation triples
steps.description: Extract one (sentence, cite_key, claim) triple per cite-key occurrence across all content — no sampling. Coordinator verifies: Phase 15V triples-validator confirms exhaustive count, sentences present in files, keys in bib; save citation_triples.json.

steps.title: Deep-verify every triple
steps.description: 5-step check on every triple (DOI → title → authors → metadata → full-text claim support), no tiering. Emit VERIFIED/MINOR/CHIMERIC/HALLUCINATED/MISATTRIBUTED. Coordinator verifies: all triples checked; collect verification reports.

steps.title: Build fix requests for non-VERIFIED triples
steps.description: For every non-VERIFIED triple, build a fix request with ±10 lines of context and target file/line. Coordinator verifies: Phase 17V triples-validator confirms full coverage and context exists; save fix_requests.json.

steps.title: Execute bibliography and text fixes
steps.description: Apply each fix request (correct claim, swap citation, add caveat, or remove unsupported claim); update author_name_table for any new/renamed bib entries. Coordinator verifies (inspection): fixes address each request; collect fix diffs.

steps.title: Apply diffs in reverse order and re-validate
steps.description: Apply fix diffs in reverse line order; verify zero orphaned citations. Coordinator verifies: Phase 19V myst-validator confirms build passes, zero orphans, FORBIDDEN_LEXICON clean repo-wide; update section_md_vids_final (19V supersedes 14V per filename).

steps.title: Phase 20a — Methods ledger refresh
steps.description: Re-render Methods.md M.5/M.6 from the final pipeline ledger; replace any 'pending refresh' placeholder with actual gate outcomes and 'All 21 pipeline phases completed'. Save gate_phase_20a_methods_refresh.json (no Pending rows).

steps.title: Push all outputs to github.com/dhuzard/ethical-debt-AI-review
steps.description: Push content/*.md, references.bib, figures, notebooks, myst.yml, Methods.md using the canonical section_md_vids_final map (never 'latest'). Coordinator verifies: Phase 20V myst-validator confirms fresh clone builds, files match canonical VIDs, METHODS_LEDGER_FRESH, AUTHOR_IDENTITY_NOT_PLACEHOLDER; save gate_repository_push.json.

steps.title: Post-deployment UX gate
steps.description: Run tier-A static checks against the built Pages-artifact tarball (NO_FRONTMATTER_LEAK, FIGURE_DROPDOWN_COMPLETE, FIGURE_ASSETS_RESOLVE, INTERNAL_LINK_HEALTH, PLUGIN_DATA_BOUND, DIRECTIVE_RENDERED_OK, FORBIDDEN_LEXICON_DEPLOYED, AUTHOR_IDENTITY_DEPLOYED) and tier-B live-URL checks (PER_PAGE_HTTP_200, EXTERNAL_LINK_HEALTH) when the deploy URL is reachable, else emit a manual user checklist. One targeted fix iteration max, then escalate. Save gate_phase21_deploy_polish.json.
